palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward, ignoring spaces, punctuation and capitalization.

Here's an example of a palindrome that is 255 characters long:

"Was it a car or a cat I saw? That was it a car or a cat I saw? Was it a car or a cat I saw? That was it a car or a cat I saw?"

Please note that this is just one possible palindrome and there are many more.
